xrpl-to.description: Live XRP Ledger data from XRPL.to: token prices and OHLC candles, holders, DEX and AMM trades, NFTs and collections, accounts and scam checks. 89 read-only tools; it cannot sign or send transactions. Listing the tools needs no key; tool calls need an XRPL.to API key with a credit pack (from $5) or a paid plan, from https://xrpl.to/dashboard.
